messages.text:
Our records show the lunch box (unit h55-o1-u1) as received back, so it qualifies (refund-policy/v2/return). The request is also within the refund window (refund-policy/v2/window).

I've prepared a refund proposal for 25.00 BRL, the amount you paid for that unit (refund-policy/v2/amount). To confirm it, use the button on the proposal card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't count as confirmation (refund-policy/v2/approval). After you confirm, a staff member will review the request. Only after they approve it can the refund be paid.
